metadata.workstream: Workstream H: GPU Readiness & Cloud Deployment Specification

response.cloud_cuda_status: BLOCKED (NVIDIA CUDA unavailable on Apple Silicon; running on local MPS development worker)
response.engine_type: Contour-Carved Parametric Reconstruction & Semantic Albedo Projection

cloud_cuda_production_target.recommended_gpu: NVIDIA A10G (24GB GDDR6) or NVIDIA A100 (40GB HBM2e)

dockerfile_specification:
FROM pytorch/pytorch:2.2.0-cuda12.1-cudnn8-runtime
WORKDIR /app
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    libgl1-mesa-glx libglib2.0-0 curl git && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
COPY backend/requirements.txt .
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt
COPY . .
EXPOSE 8088
HEALTHCHECK --interval=10s --timeout=3s --retries=3 \
    CMD curl -f http://localhost:8088/health || exit 1
CMD ["python", "backend/app/services/garments/reconstruction/neural/staging_worker.py"]

security_hardening.hmac_sha256_verification: Implemented and active (header: X-Signature, algorithm: HMAC-SHA256)
security_hardening.replay_protection: Active (timestamp tolerance: +/- 300 seconds, nonce deduplication cache)
security_hardening.path_traversal_prevention: Regex sanitization (^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+\.glb$) preventing ../ or absolute path attacks
security_hardening.tls_termination: Cloudflare / AWS ALB terminating TLS 1.3 with automated certificate rotation
